#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <algorithm>

void addMissing(std::vector<char>& fin, int a) {
    std::unordered_set<char> seen;
    int start = std::max(0, (int)fin.size() - a);
    for (int i = fin.size() - 1; i >= start; --i) {
        seen.insert(fin[i]);
    }
    int op = a;
    for (char c = 'a'; c <= 'z' && op > 0; ++c) {
        if (seen.find(c) == seen.end()) {
            fin.push_back(c);
            --op;
        }
    }
}

void addLast(std::vector<char>& fin, int b) {
    char ch = fin.back();
    for (int i = 0; i < b; ++i) {
        fin.push_back(ch);
    }
}

void solve() {
    int a, b, l, r;
    std::cin >> a >> b >> l >> r;
    std::vector<char> fin;
    for (int i = 0; i < a; ++i) {
        fin.push_back('a' + i);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < b; ++i) {
        fin.push_back('a' + a - 1);
    }
    int x = l % (a + b);
    if (x == 0) x = a + b;
    fin.erase(fin.begin(), fin.begin() + (x - 1));
    addMissing(fin, a);
    addLast(fin, b);
    addMissing(fin, a);
    addLast(fin, b);
    std::unordered_set<char> set;
    int limit = std::min(r - l + 1, (int)fin.size());
    for (int i = 0; i < limit; ++i) {
        set.insert(fin[i]);
    }
    std::cout << set.size() << std::endl;
}

int main() {
    solve();
    return 0;
}
